title: The United Nations
text: The United Nations (UN) is an intergovernmental organization established in 1945 after World War II to promote international peace and security, friendly relations among nations, international cooperation, and respect for human rights. The UN Charter was signed by 51 founding member states on June 26, 1945. Today it has 193 member states. The main bodies are the General Assembly (all member states), the Security Council (5 permanent members with veto power: US, Russia, China, UK, France), the Secretariat, and the International Court of Justice. UN agencies include WHO, UNESCO, UNICEF, and UNHCR. The UN was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2001, along with Secretary-General Kofi Annan.
